entities.summary: Hospital Records is a British independent record label based in East London. Primarily releasing drum and bass, the label was started in 1996 by Tony Colman and Chris Goss and has grown to become one of the most well-known labels within UK dance music. The label has been home to artists including Netsky, Camo & Krooked, Logistics, Nu:Tone, Metrik, Fred V & Grafix, High Contrast, and S. P. Y and releases music from across the DnB genre. In Shoreditch, East London, Hospital runs the publishing company Songs in the Key of Knife and their worldwide events brand, Hospitality. Hospital Records is a record label in London, established in 1996. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Hospital Records has played a significant role in shaping the UK drum and bass genre, influencing artists such as Netsky and High Contrast, and contributing to the growth of the DnB scene. The label's success has also spawned various spin-offs, including Songs in the Key of Knife publishing company.
